narr: A deep moisture plume moved into the Rio Grande Valley with a low level convergence area setting up in the same area. This brought showers and thunderstorms to the El Paso area which stalled out near the Franklin Mountains. Rainfall amounts of 1-2 inches fell quickly and caused flash flooding around downtown and northeast El Paso.
ev: Flooding was shown at the Campo del Sol subdivision in northeast El Paso. In addition, media showed flooding on the Interstate 10 on ramp near downtown El Paso.
lsr: Street flooding in the Campo del Sol subdivision in NE El Paso, video on social media.
Video on social media outlet showed flooding on I-10 on ramp near downtown.
